[*]Windmill
[/list]
Rot will properly interact with other Honor modifiers.
Lich stops counting Watch over 16, as it should have done.
Nakki now correctly gives you 2 Resource Tokens instead of 1.
Wicked Witch’s text corrected to say: “... at least 4 Things …”.
Boiuna’s ability texts now match.
Catoblepas attacks all players and logs which Reserve was chosen.
Resources and Mana can no longer drop below zero.
Wights now give +3 Resources only on the first time a player moves a Graveyard.
Graveyards now give -1 Refill Modifier instead of -2.
Nymphs account for their Honor correctly.
Hiisi and Kelpie work together properly.
Meaning of “kind” is now always the overall class of the Thing (e.g. Construct, Creature, and Land).
Meaning of “type” is now generally Things of the same name (e.g. Castle, Unicorn, and Field).
Zombie infections are working again.

Wight gives Rot properly.

Eloko no longer counts itself when being Picked.
Muldjewangk puts moved Construct on top of the Stockpile.
Updated Zombie’s text to match new behavior.
Fixed a crash in Zombie.
Updated Tapire-iuara’s text to match new behavior.
Nisse correctly adjusts Haunted House’s Honor value.
Gingerbread Man treats Haunted Houses like Houses.
The number of Gingerbread Houses in the game scales like regular Houses.
Big Bad Wolf no longer locks up if a player does not own any Houses.
Hiisi works like its text describes.
Certain interactions would break Boomerang.  This has been fixed.

notes.notes:
As requested by our community, here is the release of the Russian II mega-expansion set with 9 New Things.

This set includes:
[list][*] Kikimora
[*] Vodyanoi
[*] Azhdaya
[*] Alkonost
[*] Tundra
[*] Stove
[*] Stove Sled
[*] Vasilisa Matryoshka
[*] Skull Lantern
[/list]
In addition, a new Environment, Into the Woods, is also now available.

Bug and Balance Fixes:
Graveyards are given at 5 Chill instead of 8.

notes.title: New Expansion Available: India I
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the Maori I expansion set with 9 New Things.

This set includes:
[list][*] Naga
[*] Timingila
[*] Aleya
[*] Yali
[*] Vetala
[*] Stupa
[/list]
Bug and Balance Fixes:
Treasure Chest and Treasure Key now appear in Thing overview screen.
Fixed a bug where sometimes less than 10 Reserves are chosen
Fixed a bug where sometimes Fervor items appear in games without Maori Things.
Mummy wrapped Things trigger options when Summoned more than once.

notes.title: New Environment: Treasure Chest and Key
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of a new Environment, "Treasure Chest and Key!" 

This Environment also includes 2 new Things:[list][*]Treasure Chest
[*]Treasure Key
[/list]
Try to open the chest with the key.  However, the longer you wait to open it, the better chance you'll have of getting the best treasures!

Bug and Balance Fixes:
Graveyard moved to left-side reserves.
Norn now only works with Creatures.

notes.title: New Expansion Available: Maori I
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the Maori I expansion set with 9 New Things.

This set introduces Fervor and includes:
[list][*]Ponaturi
[*]Poukai
[*]Maero
[*]Nuku-mai-tore
[*]Tipua
[*]Hakuturi
[*]Patu
[*]Wahaika
[*]Hei Tiki
[/list]
Bug and Balance Fixes:
Monoceros now properly gives +1 Mana and +2 Picks.
Increased the amount of Honor given for total Temples at the end of the game.
Fixed a crash when trying to purchase Things and Environments while offline.

notes.title: New Expansion Available: Middle Eastern I
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the Middle Eastern I expansion set.

This set includes:
[list][*] Roc
[*] Azhdaha
[*] Karkadann
[*] Nasnas
[*] Flying Carpet
[*] Dandan
[*] Temple[/list]
Bug and Balance Fixes:
Chupacabra now costs 3 Resources.
Bugbear no longer gives +1 Mana.
Fixed a bug in the Set Builder where you could choose Things that were not choosable.

notes.title: New Free Expansion Available: Bonus IV
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the free Bonus IV expansion with holiday pricing!

This set includes:[list][*]Monoceros
[*]Waheela
[*]Tailypo
[*]Chupacabra
[/list]
Bug and Balance Fixes:
Ghoul now gives 1 Honor Token for every 3 Graveyards other players’ own.
Fixed a bug in River where it would not remove reveal window in certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug in Nisse when its owner changed.
Fixed a bug where Pooka missed detecting Dumps.

notes.title: New Expansion Available: Irish I & New Environment: Mana Storm.
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the Irish 1 expansion set.

This set includes the Pot O' Gold!  Try to get more Gold Nuggets than your opponents!

Also, in this release is a new Environment, Mana Storm.  When the storm strikes, take advantage of the additional mana to summon your most powerful Creatures!

More information is available in our [url=http://mythicalgame.boards.net/]Forums[/url].

notes.notes:

Enjoy the game!
